notes: CIV-1981 (Ryan picked 1, 2026-11-26: "import what we can then have Instinct draft an email about what we can't"). Only the KML's 'Merced County' zone is imported: the app-visible west-side area whose outline matches MCAG's official service-area map and contains Gustine, Santa Nella, Los Banos and Dos Palos. Held out pending MCAG's answer: 'Merced County Greater Area' (about 4.2x larger, reaches Merced city, which the official page does not list). Left out: 'East Merced' and 'East Merced Para' (east county; Para is paratransit), the 'Los Banos', 'Dos Palos' and 'Gustine' business zones (town footprints inside the imported zone, not shown to riders) and the 'Extended service map'. Source: MCAG email 2026-11-16 (Gmail thread 1a0f5d59a3c35d65), KML zones_2026_11_16_20_02_13_city_663.kml.
